scientific_integrity: The universal statement is proved analytically by an exact stop-loss comparison. The bundled numerical verifier is only a regression check. Originality is assigned to the full convex-order strengthening, not to the already-known MGF bound; residual risk remains for equivalent stochastic-order formulations under different terminology.
scientific_limitations: The convex-order theorem is proved only for one observation from a nondegenerate binary law. The centered-gamma MGF corollary is prior-covered by the monotone-log-concave information-concentration theorem and is not claimed as new. No claim is made for larger samples or alphabets.
title: Convex-order exponential domination for binary empirical relative entropy
